summary: Frontend-only review completed against the public URL. Home renders and scrolls through all 15 requested post-hero sections in order (13,939px desktop body height). Deterministic searches, overlay search, reservations, topic/expert/conversation routing, themes, top/mobile navigation, responsive layouts, and all primary routes passed. Found dead live-room controls, placeholder footer destinations, mobile-menu accessibility console errors, and stale upcoming dates.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the Sheet logs Radix accessibility errors because DialogContent has no DialogTitle and no description/aria-describedby.
Upcoming conversations display 21–26 June dates even though the current date is July 2026; the schedule is already in the past and weekday labels align with 2025 rather than 2026.

integration_issues.issue: The prominent Join conversation CTA and Request stage button are no-ops: clicking causes no navigation, state change, or feedback.

About, How it works, Become an Expert, Careers, Contact, Help Center, Community Guidelines, Safety, Contact Support, Privacy, Terms, Reservation Policy, and Expert Guidelines all link to '/', so they silently return users to Home instead of opening the named destination.

action_items: Wire conversation-join and live-room-request-stage to meaningful demo behavior/state, or render them as explicitly non-interactive preview controls.
Implement footer destinations/sections or remove placeholder links that route to Home.
Add an accessible SheetTitle and SheetDescription (or correctly hidden equivalents) to the mobile menu.
Update upcoming mock dates to future, internally consistent 2026 dates.
critical_code_review_comments: ConversationDetail renders CTA testId='conversation-join' without either a to or onClick prop; CTA therefore renders a button with no behavior. LiveRoomPreview similarly renders live-room-request-stage without an onClick handler.
Footer.jsx hardcodes all Company, Support, and Legal destinations to '/'; App.js also sends every unknown path to Home rather than a Not Found route, masking bad destinations.
Header.jsx uses SheetContent without SheetTitle/SheetDescription, directly causing the reproduced Radix console errors at 390px and 430px.
Home repeatedly emits a Framer Motion warning that the scroll container needs non-static positioning; inspect the Hero useScroll/Lenis container setup.
Several secondary interactive controls lack data-testid attributes (search result buttons, Clear, related-field links, back links, and mobile-menu CTA), contrary to the stated testability standard.
seed_data_creation: No backend data. Reservation tests used and cleared browser localStorage key 'experia-reservations'; theme tests used 'experia-theme'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest the two live-room controls, all placeholder footer links, mobile Sheet accessibility console output at 390/430px, and refreshed upcoming dates. Core search, reservation, routing, theme, layout, and responsive flows passed. Home section positions were verified from Trust Strip at y=1080 through Footer at y=13408.
rca_of_the_issue: Dead controls are caused by missing to/onClick props in ConversationDetail and LiveRoomPreview. Dead footer navigation comes from COLUMNS entries all using '/'. Mobile console errors come from SheetContent lacking required Radix title/description elements. Stale schedule dates are static values in mockData.js.
